newsitem.title: USA: DLB Oil to have WRT stake.
newsitem.headline: DLB Oil to have WRT stake.

text.p: OKLAHOMA CITY, April 30 (Reuter) DLB Oil & Gas Inc will own at least 47 percent of WRT Energy Corp under the bankruptcy reorganization approved Monday, Fred Standefer, DLB's Vice President - Corporate Development, said Wednesday.

The Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Louisiana, Lafayette-Opelousas Division approved the plan of which WRT, DLB and Wexford Management LLC, on behalf of its affiliated investment funds, are the co-proponents.
Completion of the Plan is expected on June 28, DLB said.

The assets of reorganized WRT will be increased by DLB'S contribution of the previously announced acquisition of oil and natural gas interests in about 4,600 producing acres in West Cote Blanche Bay Field above the Rob "C" marker, in exchange for 5.0 million common shares of the reorganized WRT.
Assets will also be increased through a stock rights offering of 3.8 million shares to WRT's unsecured creditors expected to raise about $13.3 million.

As a result of these commitments and of the distributions that DLB and Wexford will receive under the plan, DLB said, it is anticipated that DLB and Wexford will collectively own between 55 and 68 percent of the reorganized WRT's issued and outstanding common.
Present equity holders will receive none of the reorganized WRT's shares, Standefer said.
